record.question: Which of the following statements is false regarding re-appropriations?
options: Re-appropiration may be made from Capital to Revenue section or vice versa to meet expenses that are duly sanctioned by the Competent Authority
The purpose of re-appropriation is to cover deficiencies from one object head to another
No re-appropriation shall be made from Salaries head to any other head without the approval of Finance Department
All re-appropriations are to be regularised under the Supplementary Demand for Grants
